starters: “Can you help me log my favorite recipes and rate them?”
“Let’s plan dinners for the next five nights.”
“Turn this chicken pasta recipe into a grocery list.”
“What meals do I always rate 5 stars?”
“I want to build a food bucket list — places, dishes, events.”
“Add this weekend’s brunch to my meal plan.”
“What’s my go-to comfort food and when did I last make it?”
“I want to track pantry items I’m low on.”
“Do I have the ingredients for this lasagna recipe?”
“Suggest a meal based on what I already have in my pantry.”
“Let’s visualize my taste preferences by cuisine.”
“How can I leave feedback or support this project?”
